title: 3D printing
description: Exploring additive manufacturing for small-batch sculptural pieces. Curious about mixing resin and FDM textures in one object.

title: 4D time structures
description: Sketches for objects that visibly change shape over time, not just space. Thinking shape-memory materials and slow-release mechanisms.

title: knitting
description: Chunky, hand-knit textures with irregular tension as a deliberate design choice. Could pair with the wheel pottery glaze studies.

title: garment rendering
description: Testing cloth simulation software to visualize garments before cutting real fabric. Want believable drape and weight without a physical sample.

title: wheel pottery
description: Weeknight throwing sessions — small vessels, asymmetric rims, unglazed bases. A slower, tactile counterpart to the digital work.

title: glass blowing
description: One intro class down and already hooked on the timing and heat. Want to try color-layering technique next.

title: oil paint
description: Returning to oils after years of working only digitally. Studying wet-on-wet blending for skin tones.

title: Prada fw 26
description: Runway notes: structured tailoring against soft draping, high-contrast textures throughout. Good reference for the garment rendering test.

title: rock music
description: layers upon layers in the genre, all referencing each other but adding new context. all political in a new way

title: contemporary art - virgil abloh
description: the ephemeral nature of what can be considered art confuses me. artists like abloh or warhol

title: baroque era
description: color and pastels coming back in a big way this szn across designers/houses. are we entering into the baroque once again? 2013-16 noticed sm similar. what does this say about the environment?
